transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this pre-submission review. As you know, the state attorney general has proposed resolving the consumer-protection inquiry into our automatic-renewal practices through an assurance-of-voluntary-compliance filing. I have final authority to approve the filing package before submission, but before I make that decision, I need to hear from each of you. The current draft requires us to describe our remediation program, but it does not yet specify the final customer-remedy numbers, contract-flow settings, monitoring period, or liability language. I'd like to go around the table and get each of your recommendations on those open items. Let's start with consumer-protection counsel.
